title: HERMES Phase-2 shadow decision JSONL record (storage-hardening design view)
description: DESIGN-ONLY. The per-line record shape written append-only by utils/hermes_sss_jsonl_writer to the MOUNTED evidence path when (and only when) an explicitly enabled shadow adapter evaluates. This schema documents the FIXED, closed record shape that is the primary N-2 defence (redaction scan is defence-in-depth). No file/dir is created at image start; the writer creates the directory lazily on first successful append of an enabled adapter. Fields are illustrative of the design contract; the authoritative producer is the code at base adc21c4d.

record_utc.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp the record was constructed. Everything UTC.

runtime_identity.description: Identity of the emitting runtime (container/runner generation). Binds evidence to a runtime.

source_sha.description: Canonical source SHA the running image was built from (image label). Distinguishes capability-present from capability-active evidence.

connection_generation.description: Stream connection generation associated with the observation, or null when unavailable (unavailable != false).

shadow_decision.description: The shadow proposal (proposal-only; never an authority; never an executable command).

current_authority_observation.description: READ-ONLY copy of what the current (Mode-C) authority did, observed WITHOUT consuming the one-shot recovery request or acknowledging it. May be UNAVAILABLE.

same_source_provenance.description: Single canonical provenance id for AdapterHealth.last_tick_at plus how many interpretations (heartbeat, shared-progress) derived from it. Preserves the same-surface collapse guard so a single surface cannot self-corroborate.
